hessian_source: TS normal modes from $LAD/dft_final/<rxn>/work/ts.hess (ORCA 6.1.1 XTB2 ALPB(water) Freq at the exact label TS; no DFT TS Hessian survives = spec fallback). Molecule Hessians: ORCA 6.1.1 '! XTB2 ALPB(water) Freq' (bundled otool_xtb = xtb 6.7.1; the same header as the TS Hessians), computed in the run step, cached in $MLT/dft/hess/<mol_id>.hess.gz (one per molecule, under a per-molecule lock; the 3 structures of a molecule are in one slice).

dedupe.method: unique molecule = the LADDER Phase Q molecule key of (reaction, fragment) as stored in labels_d1_cr2 cr.key1 / cr.key2 ('<kind>:' + RDKit canonical isomeric SMILES, enantiomers merged, constrained dipoles '|fixed:<state>'; refs_q D4). Geometry = the key member with the lowest original label e_frag{k}_rel_eh (ties: smallest job_id) = the Q:label_min reference of the cr2 labels. Tags = union over all targets with that key (mlt_common.tag_list).

decisions.G-hess: TS normal modes from $LAD/dft_final/<rxn>/work/ts.hess (ORCA 6.1.1 XTB2 ALPB(water) Freq at the exact label TS; no DFT TS Hessian survives = spec fallback). Molecule Hessians: ORCA 6.1.1 '! XTB2 ALPB(water) Freq' (bundled otool_xtb = xtb 6.7.1; the same header as the TS Hessians), computed in the run step, cached in $MLT/dft/hess/<mol_id>.hess.gz (one per molecule, under a per-molecule lock; the 3 structures of a molecule are in one slice).
decisions.G-modes: normal modes: symmetrised Cartesian Hessian, mass weighted with the .hess masses, restricted to the orthogonal complement of the mass-weighted translations + rotations (SVD rank: 6, or 5 if linear), eigendecomposed; nu = sign(l) sqrt|l| x 5140.49 cm-1 (checked against the .hess frequencies).
decisions.G-near: ts_near / react_disp: modes with nu >= 50 cm-1 only (imaginary and soft modes skipped); amplitudes c_i = z_i / sqrt(l_i), z ~ N(0,1) (equal expected energy per mode), scaled so E = 1/2 sum l_i c_i^2 = E_target ~ U[0.5, 3] kcal/mol; a draw that moves any atom > 0.3 A is redrawn (<= 50 draws), then the draw with the smallest max displacement is scaled down to 0.3 A (capped; the smaller E_harm recorded).
decisions.G-imag: ts_imag: the xTB imaginary mode if there is exactly one and its forming-bond coefficient (mean over the 2 label forming bonds of the bond-length change per A of max atom motion) >= 0.2; otherwise the mode with nu < 300 cm-1 (imaginary included) with the largest |coefficient| (choice recorded). Step s solved (Newton on exact distances) so mean(d_k(s) - d_k(0)) = sign x U[0.05, 0.15] A, sign +-1 (p = 0.5).
decisions.G-rng: numpy default_rng(SEED + rxn_id) per reaction (draws: E1, E2, |delta|, sign, then the directions); default_rng([SEED, int(sha256(mol_key)[:12], 16)]) per molecule (E1, E2, directions); G-2 sample default_rng(SEED + 2); G-0 sample default_rng(SEED + 3). SEED = mlt_common.SEED.
decisions.G-refs: label reactant geometries = the D1 ref_dipole.xyz / ref_dipolarophile.xyz ($D1PAIR_SCRATCH/d1_jobs/T#####, as the spec says); $LAD/dft_final rel1 / rel2 are the D1-HF per-reaction copies of the same coordinates.
decisions.G-dedupe: unique molecule = the LADDER Phase Q molecule key of (reaction, fragment) as stored in labels_d1_cr2 cr.key1 / cr.key2 ('<kind>:' + RDKit canonical isomeric SMILES, enantiomers merged, constrained dipoles '|fixed:<state>'; refs_q D4). Geometry = the key member with the lowest original label e_frag{k}_rel_eh (ties: smallest job_id) = the Q:label_min reference of the cr2 labels. Tags = union over all targets with that key (mlt_common.tag_list).
decisions.G-frag: TS fragments: atoms tagged (1) / (2) in the D1 sp/eda.inp (authoritative; the tags are not the first n_f1 atoms in general), coordinates exactly as in the label TS, TS atom order; n_f{k} and the element sequence of the D1 reference are checked; charge = label charge{k}, multiplicity 1.
decisions.G-2sel: G-2 pool: G_status.csv status ok, a usable G2 xTB Hessian (g3l.hess_check rules: $G2/g2_final/<rxn>/.done, ts.xyz, work/ts.hess $atoms in ts.xyz order, dim 3N, XTB2 on the ts.inp '!' line; geometry within 1e-4 A AFTER removing a common translation — deviation from g3l's no-shift rule: 464 G2-ok Hessians are pure rigid translations of ts.xyz (residual <= 5e-8 A), which leave a Cartesian Hessian unchanged, and excluding them would under-sample the 'different' class; the raw shift is recorded), minus the L.* (G3L) and B.* (Part B) reactions of $G3/O/units. Strata dipole x same_ts_g1 (C_compare.csv True = same, False = different, blank = none); 400 allocated proportionally (largest remainder, ties in stratum order); uniform draw without replacement in each stratum.
decisions.G-2run: G-2 OptTS input = g3l.g3l_text(opt.d1(), G2 TS (label order), label charge, label forming bonds) (Part B text with InHess Read / InHessName "g2.hess", no Calc_Hess / Recalc_Hess, Trust -0.1, MaxIter 100, %pal 8, %maxcore 3000, + Freq); g2.hess = byte copy of $G2/g2_final/<rxn>/work/ts.hess (sha256 from the plan); d1_g3 imported with D1G3_SCRATCH = $MLT/dft/g2/_d1g3 (nothing written under $G3); ORCA run by this file in node-local tmp with opt.d1() env (OpenMPI 4.1.8f, binding none); infra death (no SCF) rerun once; no reopt. The input builder is checked against a G3L unit input before every run_g2.
decisions.G-2steps: every OptTS geometry with an energy and a CARTESIAN GRADIENT (orca_io.read_out_steps; consecutive duplicates dropped) is a record whatever the run outcome; the last step of a converged run has kind ts_final_g2 (one record, not duplicated as g2_path): path = g2_path + ts_final_g2. ORCA's converged geometry (ts.xyz, energy-only final evaluation, no gradient) is one sub-threshold step past that last gradient step (G3L outputs: 0.001-0.011 A; recorded per unit as final_vs_last_step_A); no extra EnGrad.
decisions.G-run: run: the group's structures are packed into n slices by LPT on n_atoms^3 (a molecule's ref + 2 disp stay together); a slice runs largest first with SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK serial ORCA workers in node-local $TMPDIR; no new structure when < 2 h of the 48 h wall remain (MLT_JOB_T0).
decisions.G-retry: EnGrad failure (no normal termination, SCF not converged, missing / inconsistent .engrad) -> one rerun of the same input, then a fail record with the reason (kept: not rerun on resubmission). Unexpected python errors write no record (> 20 per task = halt, exit 3).
decisions.G-0: G-0: 50 EnGrads drawn from the G1 + G3 plan, 10 per n_atoms quintile (seeded), + 10 undisplaced label TSs at the n_atoms quantiles 0.05 .. 0.95 (kind ts_label, kept in G1), + 2 G-2 pilots = the 'different' class reactions of the G-2 sample at its n_atoms tertiles (G3L covered only 'same'); all are normal records.
decisions.G-0fit: cost: EnGrad core-h = wall x 1, fitted core-h = a N^b (log-log least squares, ok G-0 EnGrads) summed over every planned G1 + G3 structure, + molecule Hessians at their measured mean, + the 10 ts_label; G-2 core-h = wall x 8, a N^b fitted on the 20 G3L units + the pilots, x max(1, mean pilot / fit); total > 5,000 core-h -> exit 3 (spec STOP).
decisions.G-parity: parity: max |gradient| of the undisplaced label TS (median expected <= 5e-4 Eh/bohr); median > 1e-3 = level mismatch -> exit 3 (guard added here; not a spec STOP).

energy_checks.note: de_dft = E(displaced) - E(label TS) at the label level; e_harm = xTB harmonic energy of the displacement (ts_near only) — same order expected (unit check)
